

Note:

BlissOS is an Android system. The guest image ships no `rsync`, `sshfs` or
`nfs` support, and Android has no package manager to install them over ssh.
So only `sync: scp` (and `sync: no`) can work.

For convenience, the default `rsync` sync mode automatically falls back to
`scp` on BlissOS, so you can simply omit the `sync` option.
